stops.note: used for nobles in the Orkhon inscriptions of the 730s, the oldest known texts in a Turkic language
the title of provincial governors; the Beys of Tunis kept it until Tunisia abolished its monarchy in 1957
brought home by English merchants and travellers in the Levant; its feminine 'begum' reached English separately through India
stops.meaning: a Turkish governor or title of respect

current_meaning: a Turkish title for a governor or chief, and formerly a polite form of address for a man
